_comment: FALLBACK goals only. The live dashboard reads targets from the Notion 'Company Goals' database (Metric Key -> Value) for the current Period; these values are used only if that row is missing or the Goals DB is unreachable. Quarter dates live here because the Goals DB stores values, not the calendar.
_dates_comment: EDIT THESE EACH QUARTER. baselineWeekStart = the Monday of the week we measure quarterly spread growth FROM (usually the week BEFORE the quarter). quarterStart/quarterEnd = the actual quarter window (Mon..Sun) used to count starts, pending, dump-in, meetings. The In/Out growth chart runs from baselineWeekStart through quarterEnd.

raffle._comment: Qualifying start = weekly spread >= threshold. Every batchSize qualifying STARTED placements triggers a drawing; AM + recruiter each earn 1 ticket per qualifying start (2 tickets/start).

dumpinCarryInExclusion._comment: Q3-planning carry-ins created 2026-06-29..2026-07-15, before the quarterly kickoff. Already locked up in Q2, so they are not part of this quarter's net-new go-get. REPLACE with a Notion tag on those records and filter in rebuild_queries.json; reset to 0 each quarter.

_renewals_comment: Contractors the team has confirmed will renew. Excluded from next-quarter attrition in the rolling lock-up goal. Best fix is updating Actual End Date in Notion; clear names from here once that is done.

lockupGoalOverride.note: $9,446 lock-up target for this week · rolling next-quarter goal starts 9/21
lockupGoalOverride._comment: Holds the lock-up tile at the figure already published to the team this week so a mid-week rebuild cannot move it. Expires after throughDate (Sunday); the rolling roll-forward goal then takes over automatically. Safe to delete once expired.
